note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: Rail material reads as streaky dark metal and the grey edge highlights are lost; the 1:1 centre crop is entirely magenta, so fine detail is unverified.
flags.fix: Re-crop the 1:1 panel over a rail and a rung section; if the rails are still darker than the original, lift the lab-inject luminance toward the original rail grey.

flags.problem: Flat grey path becomes pebbly speckled stone, and the 1:1 crop shows a dark blurred fringe around the path edges (halo). Original path is flat graphic grey.
flags.fix: Keep the path region flat grey: exclude path pixels from lab-inject and grain, and remove the dark edge fringe by re-matching the path boundary colour to the original.

flags.problem: At 1:1 the blue-grey tile panel looks smeared into vertical streaks; the crisp tile grid and red mortar lines from the original are blurred away.
flags.fix: Reduce vertical brushing strength on the tile grid, or re-inject the mortar grid lines at full contrast after brushing.
